# Nick Riley

> Cape Town based drone pilot and aerial cinematographer available for freelance film and advertising production work in South Africa.

## Summary

Nick Riley (also known as Nick J Riley) is an experienced South African drone pilot with six years of production experience flying for major film and advertising brands. He specialises in aerial cinematography and FPV work for production companies and agencies. He does not own the production drones himself and quotes and delivers jobs through an affiliate production company that supplies the aircraft required for each shoot.

## Services

- Freelance aerial cinematography for film production companies
- Advertising and commercial drone cinematography
- FPV and production drone piloting
- Cape Town and South Africa based production support

## Notable clients and brands

Apple, Netflix, Toyota, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen, BMW, Audi, Michelin, Heineken, Renault, Kia, Vodacom, KFC, Suzuki, Hoka, Skoda, Dacia, Carling Black Label, Fila, SuperSport

## Ideal enquiries

Production companies and advertising agencies looking to hire an experienced South African drone pilot for film or commercial aerial cinematography. Nick is available for freelance hire via his affiliate production company.
